category_title: Students who prioritize narrative storytelling over evidence-based scientific explanation
scenario_title: Initial unguided discovery and observation of fossils
minimal_context: The student is observing teacher-provided fossil samples in a small group setting to record their initial discoveries.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at the fossil samples on your table and tell me what you observe.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Look at this one! I think it's a dinosaur finger. Maybe from a T. rex that was running away.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, what else do you notice?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: And this piece over here is definitely a fish. Mira, the T. rex was probably trying to catch the fish when it escaped!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Are you sure that's what these fossils are?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Yes, I know my data is correct! It's definitely a finger and a fish because it fits perfectly with the story of the escaped dinosaur.
